description: Tucked into the heart of San Francisco's beloved Inner Richmond District, this beautifully renovated TIC (Tenancy in Common) blends classic charm with modern upgrades an increasingly rare find in today's competitive market. 523 (Lower Unit) offers a comfortable and inviting layout with 2 bedrooms and 1 bath, an inviting living room, and an eat-in kitchen perfect for casual dining. French patio doors open gracefully to a landscaped rear yard, creating an easy indoor-outdoor flow ideal for entertaining or quiet relaxation. The space has been thoughtfully updated with engineered flooring, recessed lighting, and modernized systems throughout. Additional improvements include tankless water heaters and fresh interior and exterior paint, offering a turnkey opportunity for owner occupants. Location is everything and the Inner Richmond delivers. Positioned just minutes from Golden Gate Park, residents enjoy unparalleled access to green space, museums, and outdoor recreation. Clement Street's vibrant corridor offers a dynamic mix of acclaimed dining, local markets, and everyday conveniences, while Geary Boulevard provides excellent public transit options for easy commuting across the city.
